map._note: Bug 051: the Figma map image (86:807, assets/contact-page/map.png; restored by the user on 9 Oct 2026 in place of the neutral SVG drawing, for now) is the placeholder until the Google map loads (lazy, when the section is near the screen or a hospital is chosen). On load the map shows a marker for every hospital of the edition (Global: all, /ae: UAE, /sa: KSA) and fits them; choosing a hospital in the form zooms to its marker and shows our card (name + address from hospitals.json, never Google's place name, and the directions link). Positions: hospitals.json location (no searches). directions = the card link label ('Open in Google Maps', the approved label of the hospital pages; no approved Arabic yet, R053). The map's accessible name = the header's 'Our Hospitals' label (EN / AR).
